query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_all FROM tool_usage_events; SELECT COUNT(*) as total_today FROM tool_usage_events WHERE createdAt >= CURDATE(); SELECT COUNT(*) as total_yesterday FROM tool_usage_events WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND createdAt < CURDATE();
